apple.name: Chaupaal: News, Chat & Games
apple.subtitle: Talk, play and catch up
apple.promotionalText: Your daily news quiz, real discussions, friends and party games — in one warm place. Play with virtual chips only: no real money, ever.
apple.description:
Chaupaal is a friendly square for your day: catch up on the news, talk about what matters, and play with friends.

AKHBAAR — A short daily news quiz in your language, with clear sources.

PEEPAL — Ask questions and get real answers from people who know. Teens get stricter filters automatically.

DUNIYA — Share posts and stories with friends or everyone. You choose who sees what.

BAITHAK — Chat with friends and groups, start voice rooms (Mehfil) and plan game nights.

DANGAL — 25+ games: word puzzles, trivia, party games like Charades and Most Likely To, classics like Carrom, Chess and Ludo. Some games use virtual chips — they have no cash value, can't be bought or withdrawn, and 18+ chip games are hidden for teens.

SAFE BY DESIGN
• Teen mode for under-18s: messages only from friends, stricter content filters, 18+ games hidden.
• Report anything in two taps; every decision comes with reasons and a way to appeal.
• Download your data or delete your account anytime in Settings → Privacy & data.
• We don't sell your data and there are no third-party ads.

Available in 19 languages.
apple.whatsNew:
• Report flow on every post, message, profile and room, with reasons and appeals
• "Why am I seeing this?" on recommendations
• Privacy & data: download your data, delete your account, tracking choices
• Teen mode improvements
